title: Agreement Between Arterial, Central Venous, and Peripheral Venous Lactate in the Intensive Care Unit
brief_summary: The main objective of this study is to examine the agreement between arterial, central venous, and peripheral venous lactate values in a population of medical Intensive Care Unit (ICU) patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients 18 years or older
* Admitted to the Intensive Care Unit (ICU)
* Determined by their treating clinicians to require both a central venous line and arterial line

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
